text:
deploy-bot: Rollforward started for inference-gateway -> v2.4.1 (canary: 10% -> 30%). initiating staged rollforward. dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/infer/rollouts

incident-bot: ALERT: elevated 5xx on inference-gateway canary. error-rate up 0.2% -> ~7% in last 3m. Pager sent to @raja.

raja: I'm on pager, looking into logs and traces. pinging SRE.

alice (SRE): seeing a spike in kv-cache eviction exceptions and OOM-ish traces on 3 canary pods. tailing logs now. suggest pause rollforward and contain traffic.

sam.dev: recent change in v2.4.1 touched kv eviction timing; I rolled the change but didn't see this in staging at scale.

raja: pausing rollforward now. command: `redwoodctl rollout pause inference-gateway --id=staged-20260317-01`

deploy-bot: Rollout paused. traffic for canary cohort pinned at 30%.

raja: initiating containment - flipping route flag for canary slice to keep traffic on stable path. command: `/ff toggle inference_route_v2 false --scope=canary`

deploy-bot: Feature flag toggled: inference_route_v2=false (canary). routing reverted for affected cohort. :white_check_mark:

jamie (Support): I'll open a CS incident for mid-market customers. Notifying enterprise watchlist per runbook. suggested blurb: 'We observed degraded responses for a subset of requests during a staged rollout. We paused the rollout and are validating a rollback; more updates shortly.'

alice: starting rollback verification steps. plan: 1) roll canary pods back to v2.4.0 2) run smoke suite 3) monitor 5xx and latency for 15m

raja: rolling back canary nodes now: `kubectl -n inference set image deploy/inference-gateway inference=redwood/inference:2.4.0 --record --selector=canary=true`

sam.dev: if this clears, I'll prepare a patch that reverts the kv eviction tweak and add a tighter unit test for eviction race. hold on further rollforwards.

incident-bot: Customer impact check: approx 4-6% of canary traffic saw increased errors; based on traffic split that maps to ~0.8% of global users. no pager escalation to SEV2 yet but CS notified.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout reverted to v2.4.0 on 3 pods. images updated, controllers report healthy.

alice: running smoke tests against canary post-rollback...```\nHTTP 200 /health\nRPC OK\nsimple generate latency under threshold\n```

alice: metrics trending back to baseline, error-rate dropping toward pre-rollout levels. continuing to monitor for 10m. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

raja: logs show the eviction stack traces stop after rollback. looks like the eviction timing change in v2.4.1 triggered concurrent access in a narrow path. marking incident contained for now.

raja: handing off to next oncall @sam.oncall at ts=1715012720. Handoff notes: monitor 15m, keep rollout paused, coordinate patch release with sam.dev, escalate to ops-lead if any re-emergence. :handshake:

ops-lead: noted. please add the failing request sample to the ticket and include pod ids + evictions for postmortem.

sam.dev: will draft a patch and a canary-only test for eviction races, target hotfix v2.4.1-rc1.

raja: thanks team. closing active thread but keeping the incident channel open for updates. :thumbsup:
